shots.description: First visit: the Create Admin Account form shown before any user exists.
Login form shown once at least one user account exists.
Guided UI tour: the welcome step offered on first login.
Guided UI tour highlighting the flight controller connection panel.
The sidebar navigation: Operations, Connectivity, Media and Management sections.
User menu at the bottom of the sidebar with the Language submenu open.
Header status badges: flight controller link, armed state, vehicle type, flight mode and GCS failsafe.
Dashboard: application status, system information, network traffic and memory.
Dashboard, full height, including memory usage and storage.
Application status card: vehicle, connectivity and system health with a problem count.
System information card: OS, hardware, uptime and CPU temperature.
Network traffic chart with per-interface receive and transmit rates.
Memory usage chart (sampled every 10 seconds).
Storage card with total, used and free space per partition.
Data Streams: live telemetry dashboards (empty state with Create dashboard).
Flight Controller → Connection: link status, connection check and MAVLink inspector.
Flight Controller → Connection, full height, including link type, port and action logs.
Flight controller link card: connected status, port, baud rate, vehicle and uptime.
Connection check: plugged in, readable data, flight controller responding, sending to GCS.
Link type (USB or UART/serial), port and baud rate settings.
MAVLink information panel: connection, GCS failsafe, vehicle, battery, GPS and flight data.
Action Logs for the flight controller service.
Flight Controller → NTRIP / RTK: correction stream status and GPS quality.
NTRIP / RTK, full height: status, GPS quality, caster, authentication and GGA upstream.
GPS quality panel: fix type, satellites, accuracy, position stability and last correction.
NTRIP caster form: host, port, mountpoint, TLS and authentication.
GGA upstream settings for VRS and nearest-mountpoint casters.
Flight Controller → Injectors: overview with typical uses and the three transports.
Add injector dialog with the HTTP transport selected.
Add injector dialog with the UDP transport selected (not saved).
Add injector dialog with the Serial transport selected (not saved).
Flight Map: map view, HUD, status badges and telemetry cards.
Flight Map toolbar: tabs, telemetry/camera recording, storage, update rate and data rate.
Flight Map side panel: HUD with heading, speed and altitude tapes and pre-arm messages.
Status tab: link, battery, flight controller, telemetry, GPS and attitude cards.
Actions tab: arm/disarm, flight modes, mission, pre-flight and emergency commands.
Messages tab with flight controller status text such as pre-arm failures.
Gauge tab: round instruments instead of the HUD.
Recordings tab in the Flight Map side panel.
Map settings panel: auto-pan, heading, flight path trail and home marker.
Map layer picker: base maps and overlays.
Mission Planner tab: map, waypoint table and file/flight controller actions.
Radio tab: RSSI and live PWM values for primary and auxiliary RC channels.
Inspector tab: MAVLink connection status and live message inspector.
Flight Analytics tab: live mode and .tlog file analysis.
Full-screen cockpit HUD (/hud).
Detached flight map window (/flightmapwindow) for a second monitor.
Ground Control Stations: UDP destinations for telemetry and video.
One destination card: name, IP or host, telemetry and video ports, video and telemetry switches.
Video port and Enable Video switch on a destination.
Telemetry options on a destination: Enable Telemetry and Read Only.
Camera settings: camera slots, resolution, FPS, bitrate and live preview.
Camera page, full height: camera, audio, stream settings, live preview and logs.
Camera Control Panel: enable camera and camera slots (CAM 1, Add Camera).
Add Camera menu listing the cameras that can be added as CAM 2.
Camera Settings: resolution, FPS, bitrate, stream recovery rate and flip.
Resolution dropdown open, listing the modes the camera supports.
FPS dropdown open.
Audio panel: add microphone audio (Opus) to the stream.
Stream settings: Enable Live Preview with restart and stop.
Live Preview panel.
Camera → Recordings library: storage bar and recorded flights with video and telemetry.
Recording settings: storage location, keep free, retention, file length and telemetry.
Flight review player: recorded video with telemetry timeline.
Modem page: enable modem, modem type, APN, credentials and modem information.
Modem type dropdown: HiLink or Traditional (PPP).
Modem configuration card: APN (automatic when empty), username, password and PIN.
No Modem Connected panel with checks to run.
Virtual Private Network page with Tailscale selected and VPN information.
VPN service dropdown: ZeroTier or Tailscale.
Tailscale Web Login tab.
Tailscale Auth Key tab.
Tailscale Fleet Manager tab, before the drone is paired with Fleet Manager.
Dynamic DNS: enable, provider account, alias and DNS system.
Networks: summary cards, network priority and interfaces table.
Networks page, full height, including every interface.
Network priority: WiFi (indoor), Modem (outdoor) or Auto.
Network interfaces table: IP address, gateway, status, speed, type and default route.
Fleet Management page before pairing: Connect to Fleet Manager and feature overview.
Connect to Fleet Manager card (generates the pairing code when clicked).
User Management: users list with Add User and Change Password.
Management → Users with the Add New User dialog open (full window).
Add New User dialog: username, password and role.
Change Password dialog.
Application page: license manager, updates, settings, logging and database.
Application page, full height.
License Manager: masked license key, status, device slots and activated devices.
Activated Devices table with Unregister to free a device slot.
Update Application card: current and latest version, version picker and Update Now.
Version picker open in the Update Application card.
Settings card: dark theme, server port, language and Take a Tour.
Language dropdown in Settings with every UI language.
Logging card: choose logs and time range, download or prune.
Log selector open: all logs or a single service.
Database card: backup, restore and reset.
